progress_note:

Lead knee, the knee closer to the target, at address, the setup position, moved closer to the tour range. Lead knee at impact moved closer to the tour range. Weight shift, moving body weight toward the target through the downswing, moved closer to the tour range.

Hip turn at the top, where the club changes direction, moved away from the tour range. Spine angle at impact moved away from the tour range. Head sway, sideways movement of the head or body away from the ball, moved away from the tour range. Head height change moved away from the tour range. Tempo, the timing and rhythm of the swing, moved away from the tour range.

There is a lot here to feel good about.
